subject: Next steps: procurement route & security docs for pilot
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@novosys.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: procurement route & security docs for pilot

Hi Linda — great conversation earlier today, thanks for walking us through Novosys' pilot goals. Quick recap + asks so we can align internal teams: 

1) Procurement route: you mentioned procurement prefers a formal PO and an SOW for pilots. Can you confirm whether the PO will be via your central procurement system (procurement@novosys.io) or if you sometimes use AWS Marketplace for initial pilots? If Marketplace is an option we can explore faster provisioning; otherwise we'll queue a PO flow.

2) Security/compliance gate: you noted SOC 2 and a completed security questionnaire are required. Attached is our SOC2 executive summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf) and an initial DPA draft (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx). If you can send your security questionnaire we will complete it and return within 48 hours.

3) Timeline: to align expectations — what is Novosys' target sign/contract date for the pilot (approx)? Procurement said they aim to approve pilots within 2–3 weeks after receiving evidence.

Next steps from our side: we'll prepare a short mutual action plan and flag any DPA redlines; Ben can scope any technical evidence you need (logs, retention, isolation). Marissa, can you confirm commercial terms (payment method options and net terms for pilot)?

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have your questionnaire.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (PDF, 120KB), Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Linda Park <linda@novosys.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novosys.io>, Novosys Procurement <procurement@novosys.io>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 17:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement route & security docs for pilot

Thanks Diego — good to meet the team. Confirming a few points from procurement: 

- Procurement prefers to issue a PO tied to a short SOW for the pilot. Our procurement email (procurement@novosys.io) will own the PO. We do leverage AWS Marketplace for some smaller pilots but for anything requiring custom terms or a DPA we ask vendors to go direct.

- SOC 2 Type II evidence + a signed DPA are mandatory before purchase approval. I attached our security questionnaire (Novosys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) — please complete and return.

- Timeline: if you can return the questionnaire and a redline-ready DPA within 72 hours we can aim for procurement review the following week and a PO in 10–14 business days. Pilot start target: early March.

On the Marketplace note — possible fallback if paperwork drags, but procurement prefers direct PO for SOW clarity.

Best,
Linda Park
Head of Product Operations
Novosys Inc.

Attachment: Novosys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Linda's reply and attached questionnaire from Novosys. Summary for internal action: 

- Procurement wants a PO + SOW; Marketplace is a fallback but not preferred for this pilot.
- They require SOC 2 Type II evidence + signed DPA before procurement approval. They attached their security questionnaire (Novosys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx).

Ben — can you help complete the questionnaire? Focus on data flow, retention, KV cache handling, and any isolation language. Also flag any technical evidence procurement will request (logs, access controls, encryption proofs) so I can package it. 

Marissa — can you confirm whether we can accept a PO for this deal and whether we can offer net-30 or net-45 for an initial pilot? If PO is ok, I’ll ask legal to prep a redline-friendly DPA and route it to procurement. I’ll also create a short mutual action plan to keep timelines visible.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.md) with milestones.

Thanks — Diego

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan.md (MD, 3KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement route & security docs for pilot

Diego — thanks for the forward. Quick answers and next steps from commercial/legal perspective: 

- PO acceptance: we can accept a standard PO for the pilot. For a first-time pilot I recommend offering net-30 to keep the cadence simple; we can evaluate net-45 on a case-by-case basis. Please mark deal as DEAL-4821 and I'll create the quote.

- Marketplace: we can keep Marketplace as a contingency channel but given the DPA requirement we should pursue direct PO first. If the customer insists on Marketplace we can map equivalent terms but that will delay custom DPA execution.

- DPA / SOC2: legal will prepare a redline-friendly DPA (I'll push Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx to legal). Ben — please gather the SOC2 evidence and any technical supplements (retention, encryption, CVs of control owners if requested). Once we complete the Novosys questionnaire we can push the package to procurement@novosys.io.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821) — I'll add the PO contact and procurement email to the record.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
